message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the incoming data; argparse choices provide only CLI-level validation, not data-level validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local path (--data_path) with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks for any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the visible data-preparation code path.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained weights are loaded via timm/pretrainedmodels with `pretrained=True` and saved models are loaded with `torch.load(path_to_model)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, gradient anomaly analysis, or activation-pattern inspection in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses Apex AMP for mixed-precision training but there is no use of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or any DP-SGD mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a test split is created in read_training_dataset, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no evidence of strict isolation from training, and only a single metric (loss, plus accuracy_score imported but usage unclear) is used without independent validation.
No detected input sanitization: The code covers training only; no inference path is visible, and no input shape/range validation or schema checks are implemented anywhere in the provided snippets.
No detected output bounds checks: No inference output path is present in the code; there are no probability sanity bounds, NaN guards, or threshold checks on model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a vision-based deepfake detector (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
